div.div:
Colours: blue = access / session, green = file list, sort, filter, preview, yellow = upload / download, purple = synchronization, grey = infrastructure.
Dashed open arrow = dependency («use», «create», «import»), hollow triangle = generalization, filled diamond = composition.
«module» = a TypeScript module of exported functions and constants (there are no utility classes); «component» / «hook» = React.
packages/ui holds every screen: both clients mount the same LoginForm, DriveWorkspace and SyncPanel and differ only in the platform callbacks.
